references.text: Gilgal was Joshua's base, and from here the Israelites marched to Gibeon.
The Gibeonites asked Joshua for help, and he responded by coming quickly from Gilgal.
Joshua went up from Gilgal with his entire army and all his warriors.
Gideon also attacked the enemy at night with a surprise assault, a similar military tactic.
Saul also launched a surprise attack early in the morning after marching all night.
Night attacks were a common military strategy in Israel, which was also used by Saul.
The day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night, a sudden and unexpected moment, just as Joshua came suddenly upon the enemy.
